notes.content: I added in help screens to the beta branch. I'm still revising them, and would love feedback on them. Once the help screens are finished, I hope to release this version into the live game.

notes.title: Review algorithm changes
notes.content: The review algorithm has been updated. It should reward your equipment upgrades more, and hopefully provide a better feel for progressing. I am also creating tips/hints for various pages. You can see the button on the tops of certain pages on your computer. The button functionality should roll out in the following week.

notes.title: Character Customization (Beta)
notes.content:
I have added in a basic character customization that I plan to add more options to in the future. However, some changes were made to save files, so if you encounter crashing on the beta branch, try starting a new game, or going into your user data folder and delete the saves manually. This will not affect the live game.

I plan to move everything into live game in the next few months once I am confident in its stability. If you have anything you would like to see changed or added please continue to reach out

All music has been compressed to save space on drives. This may impact some performance when a song first start playing, but I don't see this as a major issue. Please let me know if it becomes an issue, and I will re-look into how I format songs.

notes.title: Producer Tycoon Major Overhaul
notes.content:
I have just opened a beta branch. I have been working on this update for a few months now. With it comes a new 3D enviroment using Cogito template from Phazorknight. There are added QoL features like song history. I plan to add more features, like the ability to listen to past songs that you enjoyed. I wanted to get this out so people can start seeing what needs improvement before a full release.

I also plan on playing around with the layout of the studio / multiple studios.

However, with this new backed, the translations I was using no longer work. I plan to slowly add them back into the future. I am sorry if this affects you, and I plan to leave the original version with the translations up until I can find a new way to do it.

notes.title: New UI + Gameplay Changes
notes.content:
This patch contains a load of changes. The UI for the main screen as well as some sub menus have been changed. There is also changes to how reviews are calculated and some new mechanics.

[h2]Instrumental and Vocals[/h2]
When you create a song, a popup will appear where you can choose the amount of time you spend on instrumental and vocals. They have different rates of accruing composition and mixing points. Also, the more total time put in increases the total amount of points you can get.

[h2]Composition and Mixing[/h2]
Composition and mixing impact the review score of your music. The total amount of points as well as the ratio between the two affects scores. The desired ratio is different for each genre. You gain these points at a rate based on your sound and computer equipment. 

[h2]Store[/h2]
You now can purchase sound and computer equipment. The level available for purchase is affected by the level of your studio. These items impact the amount of composition and mixing points you receive per hour.

[h2]Song Requests[/h2]
Song requests have been changed so only 4 can be active at a time. Further, a timer has been added. In future updates, when the timer runs out, the request will disappear.

notes.title: Engine Update + Marketing + Contracts
notes.content:
This patch includes all of the goodies talked about over the weekend. It has the first iteration of contracts and marketing. Further, this build comes with an upgraded engine and compatibility with Linux systems.

For now, only one marketing campaign and one contract can be active at a time. This may change in the future based on the feedback received.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
[h1]Engine Update[/h1]
I've spent the last week upgrading Producer Tycoon's game engine. Most of the past week has been dedicated to fixing features that were no longer supported by the engine. This is the main reason there is no update this week. I am hoping to have it tested and ready by the end of next week. However, there may be bugs that slip through my testing, so I appreciate any reports you can send me.
[h1]Contracts[/h1]
Contracts have entered the testing phase. This is a basic overview of how they work.
[olist]
[*]Only one contract will can be active at a time
[*]Once signed, you will be committed to a contract for the entire signing period
[*]Once signed, the record label will take a portion of your profits for every song
[*]You will get a lump sum of money once you accept.
[*]The lump sum is based off the streams per day you are getting
[/olist]
[h1]Marketing[/h1]
Marketing has just entered development. The main feature of this will be affecting the amount of streams and fans your music gets. My goal is to have basic functionality out by next week's update. In the future I plan to add random events for marketing you do. (ie. You do some social media promotion and it goes viral)
[h1]Algorithm Updates[/h1]
I've been slowly changing the algorithms for song reviews. I've been trying different things in the backend to get a good balance of difficulty and rewarding. This will continue through the next several updates as more features are added. If there ever feels like a patch that feels overly difficult or highly rewarding, please let me know so I can change it as appropriate.

notes.title: Stability Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay Changes:[/h1]
Achievements are now affect how much money you earn from requests. They only will affect you for the save that you achieved them in. The will begin to effect you in future saves once you reach the same milestone.

The time system was rebuilt to be more stable, and provide less confusion when pausing the game. A hour is ~.75 seconds. Please let me know if this is to fast or to slow.

[h2]Future Plans:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Minigame to do while you are making a song. This will effect the review of your song.
[*]Marketing Tab. This will affect how many fans you have / will receive for your next release
[*]Contracts Tab. This will affect your revenue coming in, as well as the cost for marketing.
[/list]

[*] Fixed bug where style selection was changed when selecting a type
[*] Fixed bug where audio would not play when song was completed

[/list]

Game Direction and Save Files:
I know it is annoying having a save file change every week, and it erasing any progress you had. This should be the last time I have to change the save files for the forcible future. notes.title: Movement, Tweaks, And Cloud Saves
notes.content:
This patch has added movement to the game, when you are in your studio or in the store, you now can move your character using wasd or the arrow keys. Moving through the doorways at the edge of the screen will take you to the world map.

The framework for a top 100 song is in place also, it just needs to be finished up. That will be coming in the next 2 weeks. In addition to that, you will be able to name the songs you create.

Once those features are added, I will be taking down the playtest. However, to celebrate, the game will be going on sale for the week following the playtests closure. 

For the EA version, 2 new achievements were added, as well as cloud saves. Now you should be able to carry progress over multiple computers.
